items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: Then we went to Suburban Garden for Jack Sheen. We worked there a couple years.

ctx.x: And then over on Tranchini opened another place in Metro. It's a church now, a great big place there on the highway. They converted it into a church. And we stayed there a while. Then we went to Suburban Garden for Jack Sheen. We worked there a couple years. And it was all with Piron. Yeah, all with Piron, yeah. And finally, Louis came down at Suburban Garden. Well, we were to go back in there, but we had a kind of misunderstanding between old man Tranchini and Piron. We didn't go, so they sat and got Louis in…
I was wondering about when you, how did you tell how old you were when you started in music on violin, taking lessons?
